defects: Nonneg hypothesis is stated on the closed ray [N,∞) instead of gold's open ray (N,∞); harmless since it's already implied by antitone + nonneg-on-Ioi in the gold, but not a literal match

Integrability is replaced by an existential boundedness condition on interval integrals (∃ C, ∀ b ≥ N, ∫ x in N..b, f x ≤ C) instead of gold's direct IntegrableOn f (Ioi N); mathematically equivalent given the nonneg+antitone hypotheses via the monotone convergence theorem, but requires a bridging lemma rather than being a notational restatement

Conclusion is Summable (fun n => f (N + n)) (tail sequence) rather than gold's Summable (fun n => f n) (full sequence); equivalent via the standard finite-index-shift summability lemma, but not a literal syntactic match
